defective_pattern: Placing explanatory narrative text under the table instead of preceding the table caption.
why_defective: Violates formal academic reporting flow where the text must introduce and contextualize the findings before the reader encounters the tabular data.
observed_symptoms: Table appears immediately after a heading without introductory text.
Paragraph describing table contents appears after the table object in the document stream.
corrective_remedy: Move the explanatory narrative paragraph to strictly precede the table caption. The flow must be: Heading -> Narrative -> Table Caption -> Table -> Table Note.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: A table object immediately follows a heading object or precedes the paragraphs referencing its findings.
